name: smwmusic-touhou-yumejikuu-phantasmagoria-of-dim-dream-hakurei-s-resolution-maple-dream-remix
title: Touhou Yumejikuu ~ Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream - Hakurei's Resolution ~ Maple Dream (Remix)
description:
Did a take on Maple Dream from Touhou 3: Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream. Definitely one of the cooler ending themes from the series and also another fun PC-98 theme to have done an arrangement of.

This baby is great for title screens, credits, athletic stages, night stages, and final areas.

Important:
There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Original Pitch)
